sequence: Waterlooplein → Jewish Museum exterior/context → Hortus edge/interior option → Oosterpark
movement_time: 45–55 min pure walking; 110–135 min with interpretation
transport_recovery: Metro/tram at Waterlooplein; tram/bus near Oosterpark
design_strength: Balanced storytelling, dispersal, rest options and moderate crowd exposure
main_risks: Rain exposure in final park section; sensitive historical content
operating_rule: Use small-group moving interpretation; optional paid-entry modules remain separate.

sequence: De Hallen → Kinkerbuurt context → canal/industrial transition → Westerpark/Westergas
movement_time: 55–65 min pure walking; 120–145 min with interpretation
transport_recovery: Tram/bus at De Hallen; bus/tram around Westerpark
design_strength: Moves away from highest-pressure centre while retaining food, neighbourhood and regeneration stories
main_risks: Less iconic recognition; event days at Westerpark can create local peaks
operating_rule: Deploy when Jordaan/centre crowd thresholds are exceeded.

sequence: OBA Oosterdok → Central Station passage → IJ ferry → Eye Filmmuseum
movement_time: 30–40 min walking plus ferry; 100–125 min with indoor modules
transport_recovery: Central Station multimodal hub + free IJ ferry
design_strength: High indoor/sheltered content, toilets, seating and accessible facilities
main_risks: Ferry wind/rain exposure; Eye exhibition closures/changeovers
operating_rule: Use OBA and Eye as shelter anchors; verify ferry status immediately pre-departure.

sequence: OBA Oosterdok → accessible Central Station routing → IJ ferry → Eye
transport_recovery: GVB accessibility planner + lift-status check required
design_strength: Best verified step-free infrastructure, toilets, seating and recovery points
main_risks: Lift outages can invalidate route; cobbles/bridge gradients still require field audit
operating_rule: Do not advertise fully accessible until physical field audit confirms kerbs, surfaces and lift contingencies.

sequence: Rijksmuseum exterior/arcade → Museumplein → Albert Cuyp edge → Sarphatipark
movement_time: 40–50 min pure walking; 105–130 min with interpretation
transport_recovery: Multiple tram/metro options; De Pijp metro recovery
design_strength: Dense alternative stops and transit exits if one street/venue becomes unavailable
main_risks: Market congestion; exposed square/park; museum-area event closures
operating_rule: Swap market module for side-street/park module when trading congestion or works block the planned path.
